output.brief: The failures are not caused by release v4.12. They come from Finance's settlement-reconciliation job (settle-recon). On 3 March it moved to a run every 15 minutes during the day, and it uses the same Quillmark credential as checkout. Each run sends a burst of search calls that pushes the credential over its 300-per-minute limit. Quillmark then returns 429 rate-limit errors, and v4.12 shows these to customers as "card declined". Failures cluster in the first minutes of each quarter hour (93%). They stopped during the ERP maintenance window on 6 March. They began at 09:00, before the deploy. In the rollback test, v4.11 failed at 3.7% and v4.12 at 3.6%, and almost all failures were 429s. Rolling back would not help, and it would bring back the card-number logging problem, which has a 13 March deadline. Next steps: pause or revert the daytime settle-recon schedule now, then watch the 429 rate and the failure rate. Give the job its own credential before any daytime schedule returns. Do not tell the board the incident caused the 9% revenue fall. Traffic mix, conversion and order value also changed, so the revenue effect has not been measured. Pull checkout-outcome revenue data first. Confidence is high.
